intro:
Spells, sparkles, and the cutest girls you've ever seen.
Play, score, and unlock them all.
description:
Step into a world where magic is real and the girls are irresistibly adorable. Pastel skies, glowing stars, and kawaii anime girls with powers that match their charm, this is the cutest place you've ever been.

Play through the minigames and watch your score open up the gallery, one stunning image at a time. The higher you climb, the more they reveal.

From bubbly and bright magical girls to mysteriously enchanting magical girls, each one has her own personality and her own way of rooting for you mid-game. They notice when you're winning.

Think you've got what it takes to unlock every single one?


Features:

● EVERY MODE, A REASON TO KEEP GOING: Test your mind and your reflexes while climbing the scoreboard. Every point counts toward unlocking more.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Score higher, unlock more. The gallery fills up as you get better, and every image is worth it.

● KAWAII CHARACTER PERSONALITIES: Every girl reacts, cheers, and teases you throughout the game. No two feel the same.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How the story closes depends on you. Some endings are sweeter than others.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Reach question 150 and discover the secret that's been waiting for you the whole time.


These magical girls are waiting to be found. The gallery won't fill itself.
Start playing and see how far your score takes you.

Are you ready?
